summary: cmd_arch meets P4's outcome: both halves read one un-overlaid snapshot (file or URL fetched once), a differing field now stops the app, and HelmCharts rendering every release but the app's must build and draw each helm-charts-drawn edge dict-equal to the snapshot; other producers' edges are reported. Two minor advisory robustness notes, nothing blocking.

findings.summary: A consumer flipped locally but still attributed to helm-charts in the dataset makes its provider's HelmCharts half stop falsely (conservative, transient)
dataset_snapshot's urlopen failure escapes main's `except Stop` and aborts the remaining apps with a traceback instead of a per-app STOP
